blocks.section: Perform angular alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Set the angular alignment indicator (A) to zero on left side of  the driver coupling half  (Y), 90° from the top-center position (9 o'clock).

blocks.section: Perform angular alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Rotate the indicator through the top-center position to the right side, 180° from the start position (3 o'clock).

blocks.section: Perform angular alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.markdown:
Figure 12: Top view of an incorrect horizontal alignment

| When the reading value is...   | Then...                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|--------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Negative                       | The coupling halves are farther apart on the right side than the left. Perform one of these steps: • Slide the shaft end of the driver to the left. • Slide the opposite end to the right.   |
| Positive                       | The coupling halves are closer together on the right side than the left. Perform one of these steps: • Slide the shaft end of the driver to the right. • Slide the opposite end to the left. |

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: Before you start this procedure, make sure that the dial indicators are correctly set up.

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: A unit is in parallel alignment when the parallel indicator (P) does not vary by more than 0.002 in. (0.05 mm) as measured at four points 90° apart at the operating temperature.

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: Set the parallel alignment indicator (P) to zero at the top-center position (12 o'clock) of  the driver coupling half  (Y).

blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: Rotate the indicator to the bottom-center position (6 o'clock).
